paragraphs: The Walt Disney Company (TWDC), commonly known as Disney, is an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered at the Walt Disney Studios complex in Burbank, California. Founded on October 16, 1923, by brothers Walt and Roy O. Disney as the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio, the company later operated under the names Walt Disney Studio and Walt Disney Productions before adopting its current name in 1986. Disney established itself as a leader in animation with the release of Steamboat Willie in 1928. The short film's pioneering use of synchronized sound helped popularize Mickey Mouse, who became the company's mascot and corporate icon.

After achieving success in animation by the early 1940s, Disney expanded into live-action films, television and theme parks during the 1950s. Following Walt Disney's death in 1966, the company experienced a decline in profitability, particularly in its animation business. In 1984, Michael Eisner became CEO and oversaw a revival of the company through international theme park expansion and the successful Disney Renaissance era of animation from 1989 to 1999. After becoming CEO in 2005, Bob Iger continued Disney's expansion into a major entertainment conglomerate through the acquisitions of Pixar in 2006, Marvel Entertainment in 2009, Lucasfilm in 2012 and 21st Century Fox in 2019. In 2020, Bob Chapek succeeded Iger as CEO, but was dismissed in 2022, leading to Iger's return. Josh D'Amaro succeeded Iger as CEO in March 2026.

Disney operates one of the largest film and television production businesses in Hollywood. Its Walt Disney Studios division includes Walt Disney Pictures, Walt Disney Animation Studios, Pixar, Marvel Studios, Lucasfilm, 20th Century Studios, 20th Century Animation and Searchlight Pictures. Disney's other businesses encompass the ABC television network; cable networks including Disney Channel, ESPN, Freeform, FX and National Geographic; publishing, merchandising, music and theatrical productions; direct-to-consumer streaming services including Disney+, Hulu and ESPN's streaming offerings; and Disney Experiences, which operates theme parks, resort hotels and cruise lines worldwide.

Disney is one of the world's largest and most widely recognized entertainment companies. The company is widely regarded as an influential force in the entertainment industry, particularly for its contributions to animation and filmmaking. Disney ranked 71st on the 2025 Forbes Global 2000 and 44th on the 2026 Fortune 500 list of the largest American companies by revenue. Since its founding, the company has won 135 Academy Awards, including 26 awarded to Walt Disney himself. Its films have appeared on numerous lists of the greatest films of all time, and the company has played a major role in the development of the theme park industry. Publicly traded since 1940, Disney is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and has been a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average since 1991. As of August 2020, approximately two-thirds of its shares were held by large financial institutions. Disney celebrated its 100th anniversary on October 16, 2023.

people.name: Joshua W. D'Amaro
people.title: Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Appointed Chief Executive Officer and became a director effective March 18, 2026. Previously served as Chairman of the Experiences segment from 2020.
people.quote: Mr. D'Amaro was appointed Chief Executive Officer effective March 18, 2026, at which time he also became a director on the Board of Directors.

people.name: Hugh F. Johnston
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Joined the Company and was appointed Chief Financial Officer effective December 4, 2023. Previously served as PepsiCo's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer from 2010 and Vice Chairman from 2015 to November 2023.
people.quote: Mr. Johnston was appointed Chief Financial Officer effective December 4, 2023.

people.name: Dana M. Walden
people.title: President and Chief Creative Officer
people.bio: Appointed President and Chief Creative Officer effective March 18, 2026. Previously served as Co-Chairman of the Entertainment segment from 2023, Chairman of Disney General Entertainment Content from 2022, and Chairman of Disney Television Studios and ABC Entertainment from 2019.
people.quote: Ms. Walden was appointed President and Chief Creative Officer effective March 18, 2026.

people.name: Horacio E. Gutierrez
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Legal and Global Affairs Officer
people.bio: Appointed Senior Executive Vice President and General Counsel effective February 1, 2022, and assumed his current title effective November 4, 2025. Previously served as Spotify's Head of Global Affairs and Chief Legal Officer from November 2019 to January 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Gutierrez was appointed Senior Executive Vice President and General Counsel effective February 1, 2022

people.name: Sonia L. Coleman
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
people.bio: Appointed Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer effective April 8, 2023, and Chief People Officer effective September 27, 2025. Previously served as Senior Vice President, Human Resources at Disney General Entertainment and ESPN from August 2021.
people.quote: Ms. Coleman was appointed Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer effective April 8, 2023

people.name: Paul M. Roeder
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Communications Officer
people.bio: Appointed Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Communications Officer effective March 19, 2026. Previously served as Executive Vice President, Communications - Disney Entertainment Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and International from 2023 and led communications for the Walt Disney Studios from 2010.
people.quote: Mr. Roeder was appointed Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Communications Officer effective March 19, 2026.

people.name: Robert A. Iger
people.title: Chief Executive Officer (as listed in the Fiscal 2025 Summary Compensation Table)
people.bio: Served as Chief Executive Officer until February 24, 2020, became Executive Chairman, retired December 31, 2021, and resumed the CEO role November 20, 2022. Included as a fiscal 2025 named executive officer; the later executive-officer section names D'Amaro as CEO and does not list Iger.
people.quote: on November 20, 2022, Mr. Iger again assumed the role of Chief Executive Officer.

people.name: Kristina K. Schake
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Communications Officer (as listed in the Fiscal 2025 Summary Compensation Table)
people.bio: Listed as Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Communications Officer and a named executive officer in the Fiscal 2025 Summary Compensation Table. The later executive-officer section names Roeder in that role and does not list Schake.
people.quote:
Kristina K. Schake 
 Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Communications Officer

people.name: Mary T. Barra
people.title: Director; Chair and Chief Executive Officer, General Motors Company
people.bio: Barra has served as Chair and Chief Executive Officer of General Motors since 2016 and was its Chief Executive Officer from 2014 to 2016.
people.quote: Ms. Barra has deep experience in strategy, innovation and brand evolution through her role in leading the transformation of General Motors Company

people.name: Amy L. Chang
people.title: Director; Former Executive Vice President, Cisco Systems, Inc.
people.bio: Chang served as Executive Vice President and General Manager, Collaboration, at Cisco from 2018 to 2020. She founded and led Accompany from 2013 to 2018 and previously held product leadership positions at Google.
people.quote: Ms. Chang has developed expertise across the technology sector from her time as an Executive Vice President at Cisco Systems, Inc.

people.name: D. Jeremy Darroch
people.title: Director; Former Executive Chairman and Group Chief Executive Officer, Sky
people.bio: Darroch served as Sky's Executive Chairman in 2021 and Group Chief Executive Officer from 2007 to 2021. He previously served as Sky's Chief Financial Officer from 2004 to 2007.
people.quote: As Group Chief Executive Officer of Sky, Mr. Darroch led the company's tremendous growth and transformation

people.name: Carolyn N. Everson
people.title: Director; Former President, Instacart
people.bio: Everson served as President of Instacart in 2021 and Vice President, Global Marketing Solutions, at Meta from 2011 to 2021. She previously held advertising leadership roles at Microsoft and MTV Networks.
people.quote: Ms. Everson brings experience evaluating internet and digital media businesses from an investor perspective

people.name: Michael B.G. Froman
people.title: Director; President, Council on Foreign Relations
people.bio: Froman has served as President of the Council on Foreign Relations since 2023. He previously served as Vice Chairman and President, Strategic Growth, at Mastercard and as United States Trade Representative.
people.quote: Mr. Froman brings a deep, unique global perspective that is important to the Board

people.name: James P. Gorman
people.title: Director; Chairman Emeritus, Morgan Stanley
people.bio: Gorman is Chairman Emeritus of Morgan Stanley and previously served as its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. The supplied text identifies him as Executive Committee chair but does not state that he is Disney's board chair.
people.quote: As former Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Morgan Stanley, Mr. Gorman has an established record driving strategic transformation of a global financial institution

people.name: Maria Elena Lagomasino
people.title: Director; Chief Executive Officer and Managing Partner, WE Family Offices
people.bio: Lagomasino has served as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Partner of WE Family Offices since 2013. She previously led GenSpring Family Offices and served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of JP Morgan Private Bank.
people.quote: Ms. Lagomasino is an expert in the field of governance and social thought leadership

people.name: Calvin R. McDonald
people.title: Director; Chief Executive Officer, lululemon athletica inc. (departure effective January 31, 2026)
people.bio: McDonald became lululemon's Chief Executive Officer in 2018; the footnote states that he stepped down as CEO and director effective January 31, 2026. He previously served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Sephora Americas and Sears Canada.
people.quote: Mr. McDonald has over 28 years of retail and brand-building experience, bringing powerful insight to the Board on integrating customer experience across multiple channels

people.name: Derica W. Rice
people.title: Director; Former Executive Vice President, CVS Health Corporation
people.bio: Rice served as Executive Vice President of CVS Health and President of CVS Caremark from 2018 to 2020. He previously served as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President of Global Services at Eli Lilly from 2006 to 2017.
people.quote: Mr. Rice provides expertise in financial oversight and accounting through his financial executive experience

people.name: Jeffrey E. Williams
people.title: Director Nominee; Former Chief Operating Officer, Apple Inc.
committees: Compensation (anticipated membership following the Annual Meeting)
people.bio: Williams served as Apple's Chief Operating Officer from 2015 to 2025 and held various positions there from 1998 to 2015. His responsibilities included worldwide operations, product development, and industrial and human interface design teams.
people.quote: Mr. Williams brings demonstrated brand stewardship and deep expertise in technology and innovation through his leadership roles at Apple Inc.
